# Yelp.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/yelp-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/yelp-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product listing data from Yelp.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Web Scrape Yelp.com (2025 update)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-yelpcom)
- **Code:** [`yelp.py`](yelp.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Business pages](results/business_pages.json) · [Review pages](results/reviews.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Yelp business pages
- Yelp search pages
- Yelp review pages

## Functions

- `scrape_pages(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape yelp business pages
- `scrape_reviews(url, max_reviews=None)` → `List[Review]`
- `scrape_search(keyword, location, max_pages=None)`: scrape single page of yelp search

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import yelp


async def main():
    pages = await yelp.scrape_pages(
        urls=[
            "https://www.yelp.com/biz/vons-1000-spirits-seattle-4",
            "https://www.yelp.com/biz/ihop-seattle-4",
        ],
    )
    reviews = await yelp.scrape_reviews(
        url="https://www.yelp.com/biz/vons-1000-spirits-seattle-4",
        max_reviews=28,
    )
    search = await yelp.scrape_search(keyword="plumbers", location="Seattle, WA", max_pages=2)


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`Review`**: `id`, `userId`, `business`, `user`, `comment`, `rating`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`yelp.py`](yelp.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: proxy pool (datacenter or residential)

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/yelp-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_review_scraping`, `test_page_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
